text:
chris: saw a burst of ECC correctables on apac-pool-3, ~4500 over 10m. Xid 13/31 mix.
maya: saw that, alerted. pods on two nodes got soft-evac markers.
chris: logs show nvml spikes then some Xid 13 GPU hangs, kubectl drain delayed by pods with local storage :grimacing:
sam: can we raise the autodrain threshold for APAC while we investigate? current policy drains at 1000/5m per card.
chris: proposal: add hysteresis and per-sku sensitivity. e.g. p4d cards use 800/10m, a100s 1200/5m, and require repeat window of 2 triggers.
tashi: cost concern: aggressive drains force replacements and reduce capacity. APAC already has tight capacity, + we pay cross-region failover traffic.
elaine: is there telemetry to separate noisy PCIe from actual ECC escalation? I saw some cards show correctables on kernel probe but no subsequent Xid.
chris: yes, we have nvml and pci errs. quick query I ran:
```
SELECT card, sum(ecc_correctables) as c FROM gpu_metrics WHERE region='apac' AND minute BETWEEN t-10 AND t GROUP BY card ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 50;
```
maya: maybe introduce a 'soft quarantine' state that reduces new allocations and enables KV cache flush, instead of immediate drain.
sam: soft quarantine is good. what are rollback conditions if soft_quarantine fails? we need an automated bump to hard drain after N minutes or X new Xid events.
chris: agree. suggested runbook:
1) soft_quarantine on trigger
2) wait 15m, monitor Xid rate and kernel OOPS
3) if Xid>5 in 15m or card temp rise >8C -> hard drain
4) if hard drain, mark for replacement queue and ramp capacity from dedicated burst
maya: add step to notify infra-oncall and tag nodes for hardware diag with sku/slot images.
tashi: also track cost delta: simulate expected lost GPU-minutes vs cross-region replica cost. Ops finance wants the metric.
ops-bot: incident created: INC-2026-1723 for apac-pool-3 ECC spike. runbook attached: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/ecc-spike
elaine: +1 on per-sku thresholds and soft_quarantine. can we backfill a week of metrics to tune sensitivity? chris, can you share the query job?
chris: I'll drop a job on airflow to backfill and post results. in meantime I'll lower APAC auto-drain aggressiveness and enable soft_quarantine flag for pool-3 :thumbsup:
maya: will update the cluster config and push canary to pool-3 only. monitoring alerts will be bumped to critical if escalation happens.
sam: once the canary runs, let's monitor cost and latency SLO. if we see degradation, rollback.
chris: thanks everyone. follow-ups: chris -> airflow backfill job, maya -> canary deploy, tashi -> cost sim, elaine -> create diag ticket template.
ops-bot: deploy started: config-rollout 0.3 -> pool-3 (canary). ETA 3m.
maya: rolled to canary, watch logs at https://grafana.internal/d/GPUs/apac-pool-3?orgId=1
chris: still seeing a cluster card showing low-level PCIe retry spikes; will collect hwtrace.
sam: flagging this thread for postmortem if we escalate to hard drain. recording in incidents channel if needed.
elaine: thanks all, good compromise on safety vs capacity.
